decision: Map only Card/Cards, Property/Properties, Step/Steps, and Callout, and fail on every other MDX JSX component
why: The eight current docs use exactly these component families, and silent fallback would recreate the raw-MDX defect
result: assumes the current docs component inventory is complete

decision: Declare unified, remark-parse, remark-mdx, remark-gfm, remark-stringify, and unist-util-visit as direct web dependencies
why: The serializer imports them directly, so relying on fromsrc transitive dependencies would make package resolution accidental
result: direct imports remain stable across dependency graph changes

decision: Remove freshness metadata instead of adding Git access to production
why: Freshness is optional, and omission is more reliable than coupling request-time output to repository availability
result: sitemap and Markdown remain valid without freshness fields

decision: Move homepage canonical and Markdown alternate to app/page.tsx while leaving site-wide descriptive and OG defaults in the root layout
why: Identity belongs to a valid route, while root metadata is inherited by HTML 404s
result: HTML 404s inherit no canonical or Markdown alternate

decision: Use one serializer through markdownForPathname for explicit .md routes and negotiated agent responses
why: Both delivery paths already converge on this function, preventing representation drift
result: explicit and negotiated Markdown stay byte-equivalent

decision: Supersede the unist-util-visit part of the dependency decision and traverse the small mdast recursively
why: The transform needs parent-aware replacement and the recursion is shorter than adding another runtime package
result: direct dependencies are limited to the parser and stringifier pipeline

decision: Represent property metadata as mdast inline-code nodes and Steps as one ordered-list node
why: The first focused test showed that literal backticks in text are escaped and isolated list-item nodes stringify as bullets
result: property metadata and ordered steps render with their intended Markdown semantics

decision: Validate transformed Step and Callout children as block content before assigning them to mdast containers
why: Next's TypeScript build exposed that RootContent also permits phrasing nodes that are invalid direct children of lists and blockquotes
result: invalid direct child shapes fail explicitly instead of being hidden behind an unchecked cast

decision: Reject a shorthand Callout type attribute instead of treating its empty string as a label
why: The different-family decision audit found that an empty label reached label[0].toUpperCase() and crashed with an incidental TypeError
result: invalid Callout attribute shapes fail with an intentional error

decision: Reject any MDX node left anywhere in the transformed tree
why: The shorthand regression test exposed that one-line JSX parses as mdxJsxTextElement nested in a paragraph, outside the root-only transform
result: inline or nested JSX cannot leak through the Markdown serializer
